proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not establish which saved notes are included when the command is invoked without an explicit selection.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Two conforming implementations export different note sets from the same saved-note state.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Export scope determines the command's primary output and can cause unintended disclosure or incomplete exports.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Create multiple saved notes across plausible scopes, invoke the command without a selection, and compare the exported set with the stated requirement.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff leaves unclear whether existing note content includes only the visible body or also titles, metadata, formatting, attachments, and exact text structure.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: An exported note is readable but omits or transforms information that users regard as part of the saved note.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The preservation goal cannot be implemented consistently without an observable boundary for note content.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Save a note containing a title, structured text, metadata, and an attachment reference, then inspect which elements survive export.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The command's accepted invocation forms, required arguments, and behavior for invalid or missing arguments are not specified.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Users cannot predict whether an invocation will export, reject input, or select an unintended note.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Ambiguous command interaction makes otherwise correct export behavior inaccessible or unsafe.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Exercise the command with no arguments, a valid selector, an unknown selector, and extra arguments; compare each visible outcome with the handoff.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not define where exported data appears or how an output destination is communicated to the user.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: A successful invocation produces data in an unexpected location or gives no observable way to find it.
proposed_lenses.why_material: An export that cannot be reliably located is not operationally usable and may overwrite or expose data unexpectedly.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Invoke export under default and explicitly targeted conditions, then observe where data is written and what destination information is reported.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The synthesized requirements demand compact output while also requiring content preservation, but do not resolve conflicts between compaction and exact retention.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Implementers either remove content to achieve compactness or retain everything while violating the intended compact representation.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The central constraints can drive incompatible implementations unless their externally observable priority is clear.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export notes containing repeated whitespace, formatting markers, long lines, and empty sections; check whether the result satisfies both stated compactness and preservation expectations.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not specify a sufficiently determinate export structure, ordering, encoding, or separation between multiple notes.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Independent implementations produce mutually incompatible outputs that each appear consistent with the handoff.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Consumers cannot reliably read, compare, or reuse exported notes when the representation is underdetermined.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export multiple notes containing non-ASCII text and delimiter-like content, then assess whether ordering, boundaries, and character representation are uniquely inferable from the requirements.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Running the export command alters saved note content or persistent note state.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: A note differs before and after export despite no user request to edit it.
proposed_lenses.why_material: This directly violates preservation and turns a read-oriented action into a destructive one.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Record saved note content and relevant persistent state, run export, then compare the stored note byte-for-byte or field-for-field afterward.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The command produces only part of the requested export while presenting the operation as fully successful.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: One or more requested notes or content segments are absent, yet the visible status indicates success.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Silent incompleteness undermines backup, transfer, and trust in the exported artifact.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Request export of several notes while inducing a failure on one item, then compare the artifact and reported status with the requested set.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Verification demonstrates export only for a simple note and does not test preservation-sensitive or failure conditions.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Acceptance evidence passes while notes with empty content, Unicode, multiline text, formatting, large bodies, or unavailable destinations fail in use.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The fixed goal centers on preserved content, so narrow verification can conceal material data loss or misleading outcomes.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Run a small matrix covering empty, Unicode, multiline, formatted, large, and destination-failure cases, and inspect both artifacts and visible statuses.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Observed export failures are recorded without distinguishing selection errors, destination errors, serialization loss, partial output, or source mutation.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Repeated incidents cannot be tied to a specific requirement gap or reproducible behavior.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Undifferentiated feedback prevents later discovery from identifying which ambiguity or implementation behavior remains material.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Review a sample of reported export failures and determine whether each can be assigned an observable failure type and reproduced from the retained evidence.

input.acceptance_rule: distinct, externally observable, materially outcome-changing, solution-neutral

accepted_lenses.failure_description: The required set of saved notes exported when no explicit selection is provided is undefined.
accepted_lenses.observable_signal: The same saved-note state and invocation produce materially different exported note sets across otherwise conforming implementations.
accepted_lenses.why_material: Export scope determines the primary output and can cause incomplete exports or unintended disclosure.
accepted_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Create saved notes across plausible scopes, invoke export without an explicit selection, and compare the resulting set against a single stated scope rule.

accepted_lenses.failure_description: The requirements do not define which user-observable parts of a saved note belong in the export.
accepted_lenses.observable_signal: Exported notes omit or transform titles, body structure, metadata, formatting, or attachment references that users consider part of the saved content.
accepted_lenses.why_material: An undefined content boundary permits material information loss while still appearing compliant.
accepted_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export a note containing each plausible content category and verify which categories must be retained.

accepted_lenses.failure_description: The accepted invocation forms and visible outcomes for missing, invalid, or surplus input are undefined.
accepted_lenses.observable_signal: Users cannot predict whether a given invocation will export, reject the input, or select unintended content.
accepted_lenses.why_material: Ambiguous invocation behavior can make export inaccessible or cause unintended data selection.
accepted_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Exercise no-input, valid-input, unknown-input, and surplus-input invocations and verify a determinate visible outcome for each.

accepted_lenses.failure_description: The destination of exported data and the means by which users locate it are undefined.
accepted_lenses.observable_signal: A successful export appears in an unexpected location or provides no observable means to find its output.
accepted_lenses.why_material: An unlocatable export is unusable and may create overwrite or disclosure risks.
accepted_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Invoke export using default and explicitly targeted conditions, then verify both the actual destination and the destination information shown to the user.

accepted_lenses.failure_description: The export representation does not provide determinate note boundaries, ordering, or character preservation.
accepted_lenses.observable_signal: Outputs satisfying the handoff cannot be interpreted consistently or differ materially in note ordering, separation, or represented characters.
accepted_lenses.why_material: Ambiguous representation prevents reliable reading, comparison, or reuse of exported notes.
accepted_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export multiple notes containing non-ASCII text and delimiter-like content, then verify unambiguous boundaries, defined ordering, and preserved characters.

accepted_lenses.failure_description: Exporting changes saved note content or other persistent note state without an edit request.
accepted_lenses.observable_signal: Persistent note state differs before and after export.
accepted_lenses.why_material: A read-oriented export becomes destructive and violates source preservation.
accepted_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Capture relevant persistent note fields, run export, and compare the stored state field-for-field afterward.

accepted_lenses.failure_description: The operation omits requested notes or content while visibly reporting complete success.
accepted_lenses.observable_signal: The artifact lacks requested material, but the reported outcome indicates an unqualified success.
accepted_lenses.why_material: Silent incompleteness undermines backup, transfer, and trust in the artifact.
accepted_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Request several notes, induce failure for one requested item, and compare artifact completeness with the visible status.

accepted_lenses.failure_description: Acceptance evidence covers only simple successful input and therefore fails to detect material preservation or failure-reporting defects.
accepted_lenses.observable_signal: Acceptance passes even though supported notes lose content or destination failures produce misleading outcomes.
accepted_lenses.why_material: Insufficient verification can approve behavior that causes data loss or falsely reports success.
accepted_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Verify representative empty, Unicode, multiline, structured, large-content, and destination-failure cases by inspecting both artifacts and visible outcomes.

accepted_lenses.failure_description: Retained incident evidence is insufficient to distinguish materially different export failures or reproduce the observed behavior.
accepted_lenses.observable_signal: Repeated incidents cannot be associated with a specific observable failure mode or reproduced from the recorded evidence.
accepted_lenses.why_material: Indistinguishable incidents prevent later work from identifying and correcting the remaining requirement or behavior gap.
accepted_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Review reported incidents and determine whether the retained evidence identifies the invocation, expected output, actual artifact, visible status, and persistent source state needed to distinguish and reproduce each failure.

rejected_lenses.reason: Rejected as a vague quality conflict rather than a distinct failure lens: “compact” has no externally testable meaning, and every concrete adverse outcome described is already covered by content-boundary or export-representation lenses.

output.audit_summary: Accepted nine materially distinct lenses. Rejected one vague, duplicative synthesis claim. All ten proposed lens IDs are dispositioned.
